# Genesis Apocryphon Column 12 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QapGen (Cave 1), Col. 12 | **Condition:** Nearly destroyed; only scattered words and phrases survive

---

**12:1** [...] Noah [...] and-the-earth was-divided [...]

**12:2** [...] to-his-sons [...] the-portions of-the-land [...]

**12:3** [...] and-he-divided the-earth among-them [...] each-man his-inheritance [...]

**12:4** [...] the-boundaries [...] from-the-river [...] to [...] the-sea [...]

**12:5** [...] and-the-sons-of Noah [...] received their-lots [...]

**12:6** [...] according-to the-word of-their-father [...] the-earth [...]

**12:7** [...]

**12:8** [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 12 is nearly destroyed. The surviving fragments indicate this section narrated Noah's division of the earth among his three sons after the flood, paralleling Jubilees 8-9. The Aramaic term for "divided" (pelag) echoes the Hebrew of Gen 10:25. Hyphenated forms preserve Aramaic construct chains. Most of the column is irrecoverable lacuna.*
